name: Gaussian Volume Mask
aliases: Masking based on volume and transparency
definition: A technique to reduce the number of Gaussians by applying binary masks to scale and opacity attributes based on a learnable parameter, eliminating Gaussians with negligible volume or transparency.
summary: Gaussian Volume Mask is a 3D Gaussian Splatting densification strategy that reduces memory usage by consistently masking out redundant Gaussians based on both geometric volume and transparency throughout training.
